description: Rainfall data from 172 weather stations in Vietnam is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The rainfall data are obtained from Vietnam's HydroMeteorological Data Center ( ), and cover daily observations from 172 weather stations. Most of them were actively operated throughout the period 1975-2006. The list of weather stations with GIS coordinates is also provided. Coverage: Vietnam. It has 3 files in XLS, ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
